remarks: Welcome to this beautifully remodeled home offering modern updates, thoughtful design, and beautiful city light views. The home has been extensively updated with new flooring, cabinetry, countertops, bathrooms, and appliances, creating a fresh and contemporary living environment. The remodeled kitchen is the heart of the home and features a large center island with bar seating, new cabinets, new countertops, and new appliances—perfect for casual dining and entertaining. The home has also been completely repiped, providing an important and valuable system upgrade.
